findings.current: The thrill of revenge mingled with his obsession with one man.
findings.defect: The source says madness directed at one person (광기), not merely obsession. “Obsession” softens the intensity of Go Jun’s state.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes his gaze as filled with madness toward one person; the accepted baseline also preserves that sense as “the madness directed at one person.”
findings.replacement: The thrill of revenge mingled with the madness focused on one man.

findings.current: Carrying both his gratitude for everything until now and his disgust toward Go Jun as a human being, Go Se-won bowed deeply.
findings.defect: The next physical action—Go Se-won opening the tightly closed door—is omitted.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says that after bowing, Go Se-won opened the tightly closed door before the emergency sirens sounded.
findings.replacement: Carrying both his gratitude for everything until now and his disgust toward Go Jun as a human being, Go Se-won bowed deeply. Then he opened the tightly closed door.

summary: The translation is largely faithful, but it softens one characterization and omits a physical action at the scene’s close.
